blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution in former President Rodrigo Duterte’s crimes against humanity case before the International Criminal Court (ICC) has removed one drug-related killing from its trial brief, following the chamber’s directive. Based on a document released publicly on Wednesday, the prosecution said it removed all references to Incident 57 from its trial brief
